units.source_text: 但问题是计划实行的具体时间。

en.t: But the problem was the exact time to put the plan into action.

units.source_text: 脱逃的时间，肯定应该是女人熟睡，并且天还亮着的时候。

en.t: The time for escape surely had to be when the woman was sound asleep and it was still light outside.

units.source_text: 可是，要通过村子，还是半夜好，否则就会情况不妙。

en.t: But to get through the village, midnight would still be best; otherwise things could turn bad.

units.source_text: 最后，他想好了以下顺序：

en.t: In the end, he settled on the following sequence:

units.source_text: 趁女人马上就要醒来之前的那段时间出门，

en.t: go out during the stretch just before the woman was about to wake up,

units.source_text: 在合适的地方先躲一下，等太阳下山后再开始行动。

en.t: hide for a while in a suitable place, then begin moving again after the sun went down.

units.source_text: 月亮出来以前，利用黑暗，跑到有公共汽车的国道上，看来似乎并不是那么困难的事。

en.t: Before the moon came out, using the darkness to run to the national road where buses passed did not seem to be such a difficult thing.
